verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a date-based API versioning scheme (e.g. /crm/2026-09/) with defined migration windows, maintains a public 'Sunsetted and deprecated APIs' table with dates and migration targets, and commits to announcing changes via its Developer Changelog with ample notice; endpoint pages also publish machine-readable OpenAPI specs. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration that the deprecation policy is reliably honored in practice, and consistent llms.txt/OpenAPI discovery (root-level probes 404'd).
